topics.name: State Identity
topics.purpose: Define each machine-significant state as an explicit identity with meaning independent from display label and UI color.

semantics.machine_rule: Owning state machine identity is exact.
semantics.availability_rule: State does not automatically imply authorization or health beyond declared semantics.
semantics.compatibility_rule: State meaning cannot be silently changed under same identity.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
